problem_statement: Fix latest_versions() so it returns the original record with the highest Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 precedence for each name, with names in first-seen order. Records contain a nonempty name, a valid major.minor.patch version with optional prerelease and build metadata, and may contain other JSON fields. Compare core components numerically; a release outranks a prerelease; compare prerelease identifiers left to right with numeric identifiers below nonnumeric identifiers and a longer equal-prefix prerelease above a shorter one. Build metadata does not affect precedence. When precedence is equal, retain the first record. Return [] for no records.
